rule: Tatoeba French sentences with linked English, passing the Phase 0 checked rule (exact French, linked English, native owner or OK tag).
Every word in a sentence is in the unit's word list or an earlier unit's, or is a name. Elided forms (j', l') count as their word.
30 to 40 live sentences per unit. Each new word appears in at least 3 sentences.
At least 10 sentences per unit use the unit's grammar point. Each contrast pair appears on both sides at least twice.
At least 4 questions per unit for QT09, each with Tatoeba sentences that answer it, listed in qa_answers.
Prefer the plainest linked English as the main translation; add other linked translations as accepted answers. Drop sentences whose only English is an idiom (as with S0033 and S0038).
If a word has fewer than 3 usable sentences, list it in review.md. Don't draft sentences; Dan decides whether to drop the word or have Claude draft them.
Dan approves the pulled list in review.md before a unit goes live.
